notes.title: Patch Notes 0.2.0
notes.content:
----------Patch Notes 0.2.0----------


[h3]A critical issue was found in the player save data storage method, so we have changed and improved the save system. As a result, some progress in existing save data may be lost. We sincerely apologize for this.[/h3]


[h2]System[/h2]

- Improved save data storage method
- Fixed an issue where save data was deleted in certain situations
- Added a save data deletion feature

[h3]UI/UX[/h3]
- Added cycle/stage information display UI
- Added custom cursor graphics
- Made it easier to insert and remove eggs from the incubator
- Added a compass for direction indication
- Added UI to check mic toggle status

[h3]Graphics[/h3]
- Added vertical sync and framerate adjustment options
- Fixed graphical issues

[h3]Sound[/h3]
- Fixed an issue where player footsteps sounded strange
- Fixed an issue where truck engine sounds were abnormal
- Fixed an issue where chase BGM played from too far away
- Adjusted some monster sounds

[h3]Tutorial[/h3]
- Improved to allow the tutorial to be accessible at all times from the main menu and pause menu
- Added a tutorial notice board behind the truck so players can always refer to gameplay instructions

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
- Adjusted the time limit for completing quotas to 4 days and allowed players to choose which areas to visit
- Made truck sounds carry farther to make it easier to locate the truck
- Fixed an issue where the oxygen gauge was meaningless

[h3]Eggs[/h3]
- Modified egg borders to indicate value by color
- Higher-value eggs now appear deeper in the map
- Fixed an issue where hatch rates were constant regardless of egg value
- Made egg spawn locations more visible

[h3]Monsters[/h3]
- Fixed abnormal behavior patterns of some monsters
- Adjusted animations for some monsters

[h3]Items[/h3]
- Changed glowsticks so they can be picked up and thrown multiple times
- Reduced glowstick duration time
- Fixed an issue where crowbars were too light and cheap
- Fixed an issue where katanas were too heavy
- Fixed an issue where shotguns were too heavy
- Removed useless throwable items
 -Adjusted item spawn rates on the map

[h2]Map[/h2]

[h3]Auction[/h3]
- Fixed an issue where selling tools resulted in excessive losses

[h3]Safehouse[/h3]
- Fixed obstacles that trapped players and prevented them from leaving

[h3]Jungle[/h3]
- Adjusted egg spawn locations and drop rates
- Modified some slopes and terrain for easier player movement

[h3]Cave[/h3]
- Adjusted egg spawn locations and drop rates
- Modified some slopes and terrain for easier player movement
- Made elevators easier to recognize

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
- Fixed an issue where kiosks on the map sold regular items instead of special ones
- Fixed an issue where items couldn't be withdrawn from auction after simultaneous sales
- Fixed an issue where player corpses obstructed movement
- Fixed an issue where players could still control their character from the pause menu
- Corrected localization issues in some languages

[h2]Other bug fixes, optimizations, and performance improvements[/h2]


----------Patch Notes 0.2.0----------

notes.title: 0.1.3 PATCH NOTE
notes.content:
We sincerely apologize to our players who may have had an unpleasant experience, as our goal is for you to have an enjoyable time with our game. Moving forward, we will carefully monitor user communities and strive to exclude any elements that could become contentious. 


----------0.1.3 PATCH NOTE----------

[h3]Language[/h3]
Chinese: Simplified and Traditional Chinese have been merged into a unified Chinese option.

[h3]UI[/h3]
Fixed an issue where the tutorial could not be skipped.
Fixed an issue where some elements exposed their ID values.
Fixed an issue where currency icons were not displayed in the HUD.
Store item order has been adjusted to prioritize important items.

[h3]Map[/h3]
Improved jungle terrain and paths.
Added additional jungle spawn points.

[h3]Balance[/h3]
Increased starting team funds: 26 -> 52
Increased basic flashlight duration: 180 -> 300
Increased pro flashlight duration: 300 -> 420
Increased walkie-talkie duration: 360 -> 720
Overall reduction in egg incubation time.

[h3]Visual & Sound[/h3]
Reduced truck sound volume and increased its spread range.
Removed pixelation effect, improving visibility.

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
Improved creature movement logic and animations.
Fixed a bug where players did not lose items upon death.
Fixed an issue where glow sticks could not be retrieved after being thrown.
Fixed an issue where the BoomBox continued playing even when placed in inventory.
Fixed a bug allowing suicide with melee weapons.
Fixed an issue where auction house objects shone too brightly under certain conditions.
Fixed an issue where voice chat did not work when transitioning between scenes.
Fixed an issue where items held in hand were used while interacting with kiosks.
Fixed an issue where continuous purchases were possible even if items remained inside the kiosk.

notes.title: ---------- 0.1.1 PATCH NOTE ----------
notes.content:
---------- 0.1.1 PATCH NOTE ----------

Fixed an issue where player data would roll back after map transitions.

Restored the Discord invite link.

Fixed visual issues with objects appearing strange due to decals in caves.

Corrected the issue of objects appearing excessively bright at certain angles.

---------- 0.1.1 PATCH NOTE ----------

Future Patch Directions

Thank you for all your feedback.

We acknowledge the issues you've pointed out and are committed to addressing them diligently. This includes future content updates as well.

We hope your time with us is a pleasant experience.

Here are the urgent matters we are focusing on, and we promise swift action:

Language Review: We plan to review and update various languages, including Chinese, in the next patch.

Bug Investigation: We've received reports of critical bugs. Thank you for your input, and we will address these swiftly. Some critical errors have already been fixed as noted in the patch notes.

Additional Content: Due to time and budget constraints, the development of new monsters and stages is ongoing and will be updated once reviews are complete.
We will share development updates via Discord and the Steam community!
